title: Temporal drowsiness state machine with closure thresholds and smoothing
description: Implement engine/state_machine.py to manage system states (INITIALIZING, READY, MONITORING, MONITORING_UNAVAILABLE, STAGE_1, STAGE_2, STAGE_3) using temporal smoothing, closure duration thresholds, and hysteresis.
acceptanceCriteria: Defines enumeration for driver alertness states: NORMAL, STAGE_1, STAGE_2, STAGE_3, UNAVAILABLE
Tracks persistent eye closure duration across consecutive frames
Transitions cleanly between states according to configurable time thresholds (e.g., closure >= 1.5s -> Stage 1, >= 3.0s -> Stage 2, >= 5.0s -> Stage 3)
Returns to NORMAL only after sustained open eyes (hysteresis smoothing)
Unit tests verify transition paths, closure durations, and hysteresis

steps.description: Define AlertnessState enum and StateMachine class
steps.details: Create engine/state_machine.py with AlertnessState (NORMAL, STAGE_1, STAGE_2, STAGE_3, UNAVAILABLE) and DrowsinessStateMachine.
Implement update(is_closed: bool, confidence: float, timestamp: float). Track continuous closed_duration and open_duration.

steps.description: Implement state transition rules and thresholds
steps.details: If low confidence/no eyes: enter UNAVAILABLE. If closed_duration >= stage3_thresh: enter STAGE_3; else if >= stage2_thresh: enter STAGE_2; else if >= stage1_thresh: enter STAGE_1; else if open_duration >= cooldown_thresh: enter NORMAL.

steps.description: Write unit tests for state machine
steps.details: Create tests/test_state_machine.py testing progression through all stages, short blink rejection, and recovery to NORMAL.

technicalNotes: Hysteresis prevents flickering between alert stages on marginal frames.
Do not jump directly from Stage 3 to Normal without verified eye reopening.
